claim: Every path that returns from a non-play screen to a sprite-drawn screen must switch the layers back on, and menus and end screens may hold their own plots that need the overlay shown there too.

evidence.text: Pause menu stub restores NEXTREG 0x69 and 0x15 on return; e_scr also turns Layer 2 on in case the menu is left without its RET.
The stubs write NextReg $15 = 0 and the next commit sets $15 = 1.
Menu icons painted in the colour set were missing until the overlay was shown on the menu; sweep menus and end screens, not only play.
